description: Adapt the existing back-pressure/frame-pacing system (EncoderSession) for Windows capture characteristics. DXGI DD has different timing vs PipeWire — frames arrive at vsync intervals, not on-demand. Handle: variable refresh rate (VRR/G-Sync/FreeSync) monitors, multi-monitor mixed refresh rates, frame timestamp correction for DXGI's QPC timestamps, and graceful degradation under encoder back-pressure (frame skip strategy rather than queue buildup). Target: no frame drops at 4K60 on mid-range GPU.
title: Frame pacing and back-pressure for Windows capture
